title: Our New Apartment
text:
Ana and her brother have a new apartment. The living room has a big sofa and a small table. There is a lamp next to the sofa. The kitchen is small, but it has a window.

Their bedroom is upstairs. Ana's bed is next to the window. Her brother has a desk for his computer. They like their new home because it is quiet.

questions.text: What is in the living room?
options: A big sofa and a small table

questions.text: What does Ana's brother have in his bedroom?
options: A bed next to the window

questions.text: What can we guess about Ana and her brother?
options: They do not like the kitchen
They live in a big house with a garden

questions.text: What can we guess about the apartment?

vocabulary.definition: a long soft seat for two or more people
an opening in a wall with glass to let in light

paragraph_translations: Ana y su hermano tienen un apartamento nuevo. La sala tiene un sofá grande y una mesa pequeña. Hay una lámpara al lado del sofá. La cocina es pequeña, pero tiene una ventana.
Su dormitorio está arriba. La cama de Ana está al lado de la ventana. Su hermano tiene un escritorio para su computadora. Les gusta su casa nueva porque es tranquila.
